title: The Assault on Clean Energy Won't Stop Climate Change
content: The impacts of a changing climate and the need to transition to a clean energy economy have been discussed several times in this Editor's Corner, particularly regarding the need to continue investing in renewable energy resources. It is easy to undo years of progress protecting the environment and advancing climate initiatives with a single pen stroke. However, it can take decades to repair the damage caused by actions threatening our environment and economy, such as those we are witnessing in Washington. Our environment and efforts to safeguard our planet from the devastating effects of climate change are under attack.
author: Echo D. Cartwright
